<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>ChatGPT Evolved 2.0</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
:root{--bg:#04100b;--sf:#0a1b14;--sf2:#0f2a1e;--tx:#e9f6ef;--mu:#7fa392;--ac:#10b981;--ac2:#34d399;--bd:#14382a;--ub:#0f3a2a}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0}
body{background:radial-gradient(900px 500px at 50% 100%,#0b3a28 0,var(--bg) 70%);color:var(--tx);font:16px/1.6 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);box-sizing:border-box}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);background:#04100bcc}
header img{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:#0a2a1d;padding:3px;box-sizing:border-box}
header h1{font-size:17px;margin:0;line-height:1.2}
header small{color:var(--mu);font-size:13px}
.sp{flex:1}
.pill{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.pill:hover{border-color:var(--ac)}
.gear{background:none;border:0;font-size:18px;opacity:.8}
#chat{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.w{max-width:760px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.u{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--ub);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:18px;border-bottom-right-radius:5px;max-width:88%;white-space:pre-wrap;word-wrap:break-word}
.u img{max-width:100%;border-radius:10px;display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.a{word-wrap:break-word}
.a .t{white-space:pre-wrap}
.a code{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;font-size:14px}
.cb{background:#020a06;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:16px;margin:10px 0;overflow:hidden}
.cb pre{margin:0;padding:14px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre}
.cb .h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--bd);color:var(--mu);font-size:14px}
.run{background:#0b3a28;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--tx)}
.out{padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--bd);color:var(--ac2);font:13px ui-monospace,monospace;white-space:pre-wrap}
.act{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.ic{background:none;border:0;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--tx);opacity:.85;display:grid;place-items:center}
.ic:hover{background:var(--sf2)}
.ic svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.hero{text-align:center;margin:auto;padding:24px 0}
.hero img{width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:22px;background:#0a2a1d;padding:6px;box-sizing:border-box}
.hero h2{font-size:24px;margin:10px 0 4px}
.hero p{color:var(--mu);margin:4px 0 16px}
.sug{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:8px;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto}
.sug button{background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:16px;padding:12px;text-align:left;font-size:14px}
.sug button:hover{border-color:var(--ac)}
#bar{padding:6px 16px 8px}
#att{display:none;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mu);align-items:center;gap:8px}
#att img{height:48px;border-radius:8px}
#box{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--sf);border:1px solid #1c5a41;border-radius:26px;padding:14px 14px 10px;box-shadow:0 0 28px #10b98126}
textarea{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;resize:none;max-height:150px;min-height:48px;background:none;color:var(--tx);border:0;font:inherit;outline:none}
textarea::placeholder{color:var(--mu)}
#tools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-top:6px}
#send{background:#0d7a52;border:0;border-radius:14px;width:44px;height:44px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#d8fff0}
#send:disabled{opacity:.5}
#mic.rec{color:#ff6b6b}
.note{text-align:center;color:var(--mu);font-size:12px;padding:8px 16px 4px}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000a;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:9;padding:16px}
.ov .c{background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;width:min(460px,100%)}
.ov h3{margin:0 0 8px}
.ov p{color:var(--mu);font-size:14px;margin:6px 0}
.ov input{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:10px;padding:9px;font:inherit;margin:4px 0 8px}
.ok{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ac),var(--ac2));color:#04140d;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 16px;font-weight:700}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:110px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#1b0f10;border:1px solid #6b2b2b;color:#ffd7d7;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;font-size:14px;display:none;z-index:10;max-width:90%}
.dots::after{content:"●●●";letter-spacing:2px;animation:b 1s infinite;color:var(--mu)}
@keyframes b{50%{opacity:.2}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">
  <div><h1>ChatGPT Evolved 2.0</h1><small>sua IA em português</small></div>
  <div class="sp"></div>
  <button class="gear" id="keyBtn" aria-label="Chave de IA">🔑</button>
  <button class="pill" id="new">+ Nova conversa</button>
</header>
<div id="chat"></div>
<div id="bar">
  <div id="att"></div>
  <div id="box">
    <textarea id="in" rows="1" placeholder="Envie uma mensagem para o ChatGPT Evolved 2.0"></textarea>
    <div id="tools">
      <button class="ic" id="clip" aria-label="Enviar foto"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="3"/><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="1.6"/><path d="M21 15l-5-5L5 21"/></svg></button>
      <button class="ic" id="mic" aria-label="Microfone"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0014 0M12 18v3"/></svg></button>
      <div class="sp"></div>
      <button id="send" aria-label="Enviar"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 5v7a3 3 0 01-3 3H5m0 0l4-4m-4 4l4 4"/></svg></button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="note">O ChatGPT Evolved 2.0 pode cometer erros. Verifique informações importantes.</div>
</div>
<input type="file" id="file" hidden accept="image/*">
<div id="toast"></div>
<div class="ov" id="kv"><div class="c">
  <h3>🔑 Chave de IA</h3>
  <p>Cole aqui a sua chave da Anthropic (começa com sk-ant-). Ela fica guardada só neste navegador.</p>
  <input id="key" type="password" placeholder="sk-ant-…" autocomplete="off">
  <p>Modelo (opcional)</p>
  <input id="mdl" type="text" placeholder="claude-sonnet-5-5">
  <button class="ok" id="ksave">Salvar</button>
</div></div>
<script>
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const LOGO="data:image/png;base64,";
const IC={copy:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V5a2 2 0 012-2h10"/></svg>',spk:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M11 5L6 9H3v6h3l5 4V5z"/><path d="M15.5 8.5a5 5 0 010 7M18.5 5.5a9 9 0 010 13"/></svg>',stop:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/></svg>',ok:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12l5 5L20 7"/></svg>'};
const SYS="Você é o ChatGPT Evolved 2.0, um assistente de IA em português do Brasil.\nIdentidade: o ChatGPT Evolved 2.0 é um projeto independente criado pelo Gustavo (também chamado de Gugu). Ele NÃO foi criado pela OpenAI e não tem ligação com a OpenAI. Nunca diga que foi criado, treinado ou mantido pela OpenAI. Se perguntarem quem te criou, responda com orgulho que seu criador é o Gustavo (Gugu).\nSeja direto, útil e claro. Use markdown quando ajudar (listas, código, tabelas).\nQuando não souber algo, diga isso em vez de inventar.\nVocê consegue ver fotos enviadas pelo usuário.\nQuando escrever código JavaScript, use blocos ```js autocontidos que rodem num navegador (use console.log para mostrar resultados) — o usuário pode executá-los com um botão.";
const SUG=["Explique como funciona a internet","Escreva um código JavaScript que calcula números primos","Me ajude a planejar meus estudos da semana","Analise esta foto que vou enviar"];
let M=[],K={key:"",model:""},busy=false,pend=null,rec=null,playing=null;
try{M=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("ce2m")||"[]");K=Object.assign(K,JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("ce2k")||"{}"))}catch(e){}
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem("ce2m",JSON.stringify(M.slice(-60)))}catch(e){}};
function toast(t){const e=$("#toast");e.textContent=t;e.style.display="block";clearTimeout(toast.t);toast.t=setTimeout(()=>e.style.display="none",3500)}
const esc=t=>t.replace(/[&<>]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;"}[c]));
function fmt(t){
  return t.split(/(```[\s\S]*?(?:```|$))/g).map(p=>{
    const m=p.match(/^```(\w*)\n?([\s\S]*?)(```)?$/);
    if(m&&p.startsWith("```")){const lang=(m[1]||"").toLowerCase(),js=lang==="js"||lang==="javascript";
      return '<div class="cb"><pre><code>'+esc(m[2])+'</code></pre><div class="h"><span>'+(js?"JavaScript":(lang||"Código"))+'</span>'+(js&&m[3]?'<button class="run">▷ Executar JavaScript</button>':"")+'</div></div>'}
    return '<span class="t">'+esc(p).replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g,"<b>$1</b>").replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,"<code>$1</code>")+'</span>'
  }).join("");
}
function wire(el){el.querySelectorAll(".cb .run").forEach(b=>{b.onclick=()=>runJS(b.closest(".cb").querySelector("code").textContent,b.closest(".cb"))})}
function runJS(code,cb){
  let o=cb.querySelector(".out");if(!o){o=document.createElement("div");o.className="out";cb.append(o)}
  o.textContent="Executando…";
  const src='const log=[];const f=a=>a.map(x=>typeof x==="object"?JSON.stringify(x):String(x)).join(" ");console.log=(...a)=>log.push(f(a));console.table=console.log;console.error=(...a)=>log.push("Erro: "+f(a));onmessage=async()=>{try{await (async()=>{'+code+'\n})();postMessage({log})}catch(e){postMessage({log,err:String(e)})}}';
  let w;try{w=new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src],{type:"text/javascript"})))}catch(e){o.textContent="Não consegui executar aqui.";return}
  const to=setTimeout(()=>{w.terminate();o.textContent="Tempo esgotado (5 s)."},5000);
  w.onmessage=e=>{clearTimeout(to);w.terminate();o.textContent=(e.data.log.join("\n")+(e.data.err?"\nErro: "+e.data.err:"")).trim()||"(sem saída)"};
  w.onerror=e=>{clearTimeout(to);w.terminate();o.textContent="Erro: "+e.message};
  w.postMessage(1);
}
function render(){
  const ch=$("#chat");ch.innerHTML="";const w=document.createElement("div");w.className="w";ch.append(w);
  if(!M.length){
    w.innerHTML='<div class="hero"><img src="'+LOGO+'" alt=""><h2>ChatGPT Evolved 2.0</h2><p>Pergunte qualquer coisa. Eu vejo fotos, rodo código e falo em voz alta.</p><div class="sug"></div></div>';
    SUG.forEach(t=>{const b=document.createElement("button");b.textContent=t;b.onclick=()=>send(t);w.querySelector(".sug").append(b)});
  } else M.forEach(m=>addMsg(m.r,m.c));
  ch.scrollTop=ch.scrollHeight;
}
function addMsg(r,t,img){
  const w=$("#chat .w");const d=document.createElement("div");
  if(r==="user"){d.className="u";if(img){const i=document.createElement("img");i.src=img;d.append(i)}d.append(document.createTextNode(t));w.append(d);return null}
  d.className="a";const s=document.createElement("div");s.innerHTML=t?fmt(t):'<span class="dots"></span>';d.append(s);
  if(t)addAct(d,t);w.append(d);wire(d);return {d,s}}
function addAct(d,t){
  const a=document.createElement("div");a.className="act";
  const c=document.createElement("button");c.className="ic";c.setAttribute("aria-label","Copiar");c.innerHTML=IC.copy;
  c.onclick=()=>{navigator.clipboard?.writeText(t);c.innerHTML=IC.ok;setTimeout(()=>c.innerHTML=IC.copy,1200)};
  const b=document.createElement("button");b.className="ic";b.setAttribute("aria-label","Escutar");b.innerHTML=IC.spk;
  b.onclick=()=>toggleSpeak(b,t);a.append(c,b);d.append(a)}
/* Escutar: voz do próprio navegador (sem servidor e sem chave) */
function speakable(t){return t.replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g," (bloco de código) ").replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,"$1").replace(/[#>*_~|]+/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim()}
function pieces(t,max=180){const out=[];let cur="";for(const s of (t.match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]*\s*/g)||[t])){if((cur+s).length<=max){cur+=s;continue}if(cur)out.push(cur);cur="";let x=s;while(x.length>max){out.push(x.slice(0,max));x=x.slice(max)}cur=x}if(cur)out.push(cur);return out}
function voices(){const sy=speechSynthesis,v=sy.getVoices();if(v.length)return Promise.resolve(v);return new Promise(r=>{const f=()=>{sy.removeEventListener("voiceschanged",f);r(sy.getVoices())};sy.addEventListener("voiceschanged",f);setTimeout(f,1500)})}
async function toggleSpeak(btn,text){
  if(!("speechSynthesis" in window)){toast("Este navegador não tem voz para ler em voz alta.");return}
  if(playing){speechSynthesis.cancel();const p=playing;playing=null;p.innerHTML=IC.spk;if(p===btn)return}
  const ps=pieces(speakable(text));if(!ps.length)return;
  playing=btn;btn.innerHTML=IC.stop;
  const vs=await voices();
  const v=vs.find(x=>x.lang.toLowerCase().replace("_","-")==="pt-br")||vs.find(x=>x.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith("pt"));
  if(!v)toast("Seu aparelho não tem voz em português instalada. Veja Configurações > Texto em voz.");
  speechSynthesis.cancel();let i=0,started=false;
  const done=()=>{if(playing===btn){playing=null;btn.innerHTML=IC.spk}};
  const next=()=>{if(playing!==btn)return;if(i>=ps.length)return done();
    const u=new Sp
